about:
Find the places where disgaea5.exe asks "is this unit character X?" by comparing the unit's class id
(unit +0x2e04) with a fixed class id or with a searched-for class, and write d5lib/data/identity_sites.json for
d5lib/identitypatch.py.  The outfit system turns a unit into another class id (the outfit's slot), so these checks
must see the base character (the Killia lookup at 0x1401cdc90 crashed on the way back to the hub when Killia wore an
outfit).
